amanda: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector roll yesterday we're seeing p99 spikes and a couple of soft OOMs on kv-cache hosts. logs point to admission allowing batches that overflow headroom.
raj: Did the selector change admission thresholds? i thought it only switched kernels.
mike: I pulled a trace. batch 0x3f had total_kv_est ~1.6GB but host headroom was ~1.2GB. admission only checked token_budget not kv_est. snippet below.
amanda: confirmed. regression started right after kernel v2.3.4. prefilling and cross-attention kv size increases the footprint.
sasha: Proposal: add late_admission step that computes a cheap kv_est at enqueue and rejects/marks requests that would push total_kv > host_headroom. also offer a soft-trim fallback.
raj: kv_est is expensive if we run exact simulation. how do we compute cheaply at admission?
mike: Heuristic works: kv_per_token = model_table[model_id].kv_bytes_per_token[seq_bucket]; seq_bucket e.g. <=64, <=256, >256. kv_est = kv_per_token * request.tokens. precompute per-model buckets. cheap multiply.
amanda: microbench: bucketed estimator errs ~<8% for our main models. sample estimator code: 
```
# pseudo
def estimate_kv(model, seq_len, tokens):
    bucket = 64 if seq_len <= 64 else 256 if seq_len <= 256 else 1024
    kv_per_token = MODEL_KV_TABLE[model][bucket]
    return kv_per_token * tokens
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for kv-aware-admission started on node-group kv-canary-2 :rocket:
sasha: Also add a soft-trim path: if admission exceed by <20% then try trimming trailing prompt cacheable prefix OR switch to a kernel variant that dedups KV layout.
raj: switching kernels during admission is risky. kernel selector needs a cost term for KV pressure. idea: score = latency_est + alpha * (kv_est / host_headroom).
mike: after enabling kv-aware gating in canary p99 dropped ~18% and soft OOMs disappeared on canary nodes. downside: short batches (seq<32) sometimes pick heavier kernel and we saw slight perf regression there.
amanda: tradeoff is expected. fix: dual-pass selector — prefer compact/small-kernel for seq<64 unless kv_est > threshold. also expose per-request header `prefer-compact-kv` for product overrides.
sasha: :thumbsup: add telemetry for kv_admissions, kv_rejections, kv_trim_actions, kernel_switch_rate. those will help tune alpha and thresholds.
raj: i'll open PR for estimator + admission hook. mike — can you add the telemetry/dashboard? amanda — will draft rollout and safety gates.
mike: on it. will add chart + alert: kv_rejections > 0.5% OR p99 latency regresses >5% over 1h triggers rollback.
amanda: also log batch_kv_total in traces and include node_headroom_at_admit + occupant_id for SRE debugging.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: kv-aware-admission PR merged to main and queued for gradual canary -> 10% -> 50% rollout.
